Using Liucent

Liucent turns IFS purchase-order lines into a shared weekly view, making delivery dates and status lucent for everyone.

Update the data

  1. In IFS, export the latest Purchase Order Lines report.
  2. Save or download it as a CSV. Keep the original header row; extra IFS columns may remain.
  3. Click Load CSV and select the file. CSV Loaded confirms success.
  4. After updating, click Export, review the file details, then click Export File to save a shareable HTML copy.

Important: The upload replaces all displayed PO lines for this browser session. Refreshing restores the data packaged in this HTML file.

Required column headers

Order No · Requisition Ordered For · Part No · Status · Quantity · Part Description · Planned Delivery Date · Delivery Control Code · Cost Cent · Created · Due at Dock

Navigate and filter: Use Today, the date picker, or arrows to move through weeks. Switch Arrivals/Creation, filter by department, search, sort, and open Details on any card.

Department cost centers

Different APM Terminals may use different codes. Enter one or more cost center codes for each department, separated by commas.

Assignments applied. Export the HTML to save and share them.
